Reviews distinct threshold definitions. A coaching effort cue cannot identify an exact laboratory boundary.

Human tracer research demonstrating lactate use as an exercise fuel.

Guidance on the added strain of hot conditions.

A one-hour laboratory comparison. Supports individual differences under duration, not a particular long-run prescription.

Gradual progression and general injury guidance.
Position statement on individualizing food, fluid, and fuel for exercise.

Heat preparation, hydration, and physiological strain.

Laboratory changes at a fixed speed in 45 healthy runners. Loading effects are not the same as demonstrated injury prevention.

A comparison of habitual patterns: a load trade-off, not evidence that everyone should switch.
